column1: # Renames for disasm/cadaver1/cad.idb (unpacked/cadaver1/CAD.EXE, PKLITE-unpacked, loaded at 1000:0).
# ea is the linear IDA address (seg*16+off). Column meanings and workflow: renames/README.md.

column9: comment
Original INT 8 vector saved by timer_install.
Optional far pointer called from the timer ISR; segment 0 = none.
Incremented by every timer_isr call (~50 Hz).
Saves the INT 8 vector to cs:148C, programs PIT channel 0 with divisor 5CECh (~50.2 Hz) and hooks INT 8 with timer_isr (1000:14E5).
Restores the saved INT 8 vector and resets PIT channel 0 to divisor 0 (18.2 Hz).
INT 8 handler: calls the optional far callback timer_callback (music tick), bumps timer_ticks and the game clock bytes at 1F722..1F728.
Decodes a packed string at ds:bp into ds:0A62 (es:[784h] segment): 6-bit codes, 4 per 3 bytes MSB first, translated through text6_alphabet (code 0 terminates, FFh entries are skipped).
xlatb through bx=text6_alphabet-1; stores the char unless it is FFh; returns ZF set for code 0.

column8: 06 1E 8C D8 8E C0 8C D0 8E D8 BA 73 4C B8 00 3D
column9: Opens the config file named at ss:4C73 (cadaver.ini) and reads 200 bytes to ds:07B0; parses sound/video/input choices. Traced in tools/dosemu: READ CADAVER.INI 1f17:07b0 200.

Opens the DOS file at ds:dx; every '?' in the name is replaced by the current disk digit (es:0708 + '1'); reads the 4-byte mjm header to cs:C8F1; if opening fails prompts for the right disk and retries.

far. Read cx bytes to ds:dx from the open data file. If the header method word cs:C8F3 == 316Dh ('m','1') the data is run through the PKWARE DCL explode coroutine (stack swap), otherwise plain DOS read (int 21h/3Fh).
The 4 header bytes ('mjm' + method) of the data file just opened by open_data_file; method word is at cs:C8F3.
explode output callback (second argument pushed by mjm_read): copies decompressed bytes to the caller's buffer and resumes the caller.
explode input callback (first argument pushed by mjm_read): DOS read of *size bytes from handle word_1F8EE.
Copies 1F40h (8000) bytes = one EGA plane page from the segment at ds:0 to the segment at ds:2 with the VGA latches (write mode 1).

column8: BA C4 03 B8 02 0F EF BA CE 03 B8 05 01 EF B8 07
column9: Programs the VGA: sequencer map mask 0Fh, GC mode 1 (write mode 1), colour-don't-care 0, no rotate/function; used before latch copies.
Drains the BIOS keyboard buffer (INT 16h peek + read until empty).
Blocks (INT 28h idle) until a key is available and reads it, skipping extended-key prefix bytes.
PKWARE DCL explode: reads 2 KiB chunks via read callback, validates header (type 0/1, dictionary bits 4..6), builds Huffman tables, decodes. Error codes 1..4 returned in AX.

column9: far entry: pushes 1DFD:0CAA (dcl_explode) and calls sub_1E052.
Inner decode loop of the explode; returns 306h at end of stream.
Incremented by timer_isr when clock_blocks wraps at 30 (together with 1F723 and flag 1F726); possibly the in-game DAY counter - unverified.
Incremented together with clock_period_lo.
Counts 0..29 in timer_isr, advanced every time clock_units wraps at 60.
Counts 0..59 in timer_isr, advanced every clock_div_reload ticks.
Set to 1 each time clock_blocks wraps.
Down-counter in timer_isr, reloaded from clock_div_reload.
Reload value for clock_div_count.

Code->char table for text6_decode, 1-based (the byte before it, 0, is the terminator): A-Z, space . , 0-9, CR CR - ? " < = > (< = > stand for national letters, e.g. O/U umlaut), then 16 x FFh for codes 48..63.
'DAC 1 HEAP TO BIG BY 0000 BYTES' error text (preceded by the 4 bytes 'mjm0'); the digits are patched in at run time.
